Interface FileLoader

All Known Implementing Classes:
FileLoader.Format
public interface FileLoader
Common synchronous loader contract for BIN, I8HEX, TAP and TZX. Format instances are stateless and reusable. It emits immutable blocks; callers decide how to use their bytes and metadata.
